# nd_config_deploy (Resource)

Triggers fabric configuration save (recalculate) and/or deployment operations on an ND-managed fabric. This is an action resource — it executes config-save and deploy operations rather than managing a persistent API object.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nd_config_deploy" "test_resource_config_deploy_1" {
  fabric_name                       = "my_fabric"
  deploy                            = true
  config_save                       = true
  switch_ids                        = ["ALL"]
  force_show_run                    = false
  include_all_fabric_group_switches = false
  always_execute                    = false
  ticket_id                         = "Ticket_001"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `fabric_name` (String) Name of the fabric to perform config-save and/or deploy on

### Optional

- `always_execute` (Boolean) When true, force the resource to show as an update on every `terraform apply`, ensuring that the `behaviour.execute_on_update` logic runs on every apply. Internally, Read resets this to false in state so Terraform always detects a diff. When false (default), the resource settles after initial creation and only re-executes when other attributes change.
- `behaviour` (Attributes) Controls when the config-save and deploy operations are executed during the Terraform resource lifecycle. Note that setting all controls to false will make this resource a no-op. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--behaviour))
- `config_save` (Boolean) When true, perform a config-save (recalculate) operation on the fabric. Can be used independently or together with `deploy`. When both are true, config-save runs first. Also known as recalculate in the API.
- `deploy` (Boolean) When true, deploy the fabric configuration to switches. Can be used independently or together with `config_save`. At least one of `deploy` or `config_save` must be true.
- `force_show_run` (Boolean) When true, fetch the latest running configuration from each switch instead of using the cached version before deployment.
- `include_all_fabric_group_switches` (Boolean) When true and the target is a fabric group, deploy changes to switches in all member fabrics. Only applicable for fabric-wide deploy.
- `switch_ids` (Set of String) List of switch serial numbers to deploy configuration to. Use `["ALL"]` or omit to perform a fabric-wide deploy.
- `ticket_id` (String) Change Control ticket ID to associate with the config-save operation. Must begin with a letter; remaining characters may be letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens. Length: 1–64 characters.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the config_deploy resource
- `status` (String) Status message from the last config-save and/or deploy operation. Read-only, assembled from API responses after the operation completes. When behaviour flags skip execution, this field is unset.

<a id="nestedatt--behaviour"></a>
### Nested Schema for `behaviour`

Optional:

- `execute_on_create` (Boolean) When true, execute config-save and/or deploy when the resource is created. When false, resource creation only writes Terraform state without performing any operations on ND.
- `execute_on_destroy` (Boolean) When true, execute config-save and/or deploy when the resource is destroyed. Useful for deploying configuration removal to switches. This flag is read from Terraform state, not from the current configuration. If you change this from false to true, you must run `terraform apply` before `terraform destroy` so the new value is persisted to state.
- `execute_on_update` (Boolean) When true, execute config-save and/or deploy when the resource is updated. Commonly used with `always_execute = true` to re-execute on every apply.
